example_sentences_in_bangla: ওর কারবারটা দেখেছো? সবসময় এমন কাণ্ড করে।
এই কারবারগুলো ছাড়া থাকলে ভালো হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Have you seen his antics? He always pulls off such mischief.
It would be better if he avoided these shenanigans.
note: Derived from Persian 'karobar' meaning business, but idiomatically used for troublesome activities in Bengali.
